name: sharp-curve-obstacle-speed-margin-v1

official_source_check.relevant_contract: camera-only float32 4x84x84 observation, finite steer/gas/brake action, deterministic track and obstacle generation from track_id and seed, six physical obstacles, CPU Python 3.11 evaluation

scope.primary_change: new final subclass overrides only COMPOUND_TARGET_SPEED from 30.0 to 24.0

factor.implementation: subclass _LaunchThrottleController and override only the class attribute COMPOUND_TARGET_SPEED = 24.0; route only bare state-dict inference to the subclass
factor.exact_predicate: current obstacle is detected AND raw curve_target_speed <= 36.0, using the inherited inclusive predicate after target EMA storage
factor.physical_motivation: If actual speed tracked the target at fixed radius, a 20 percent speed reduction would reduce the idealized v-squared-over-radius lateral demand to 64 percent; this is a conditional motivation, not measured vehicle dynamics or proof of safety.

frozen: _CompoundHazardController.COMPOUND_TARGET_SPEED remains 30.0 and every intermediate controller remains unchanged
curve formula and floor36, target EMA coefficient/order/state, detector/ROI/component bounds, obstacle side/miss latch, urgency formula/gain, curve retention0.5, obstacle steer limit0.32 and slew0.07
obstacle caps47/40, pedal thresholds, MAX_GAS, MAX_BRAKE, launch gas0.11, preview and obstacle-priority state
invalid/lost-road behavior, DrQ, explicit baseline export, HAIC path, model.pt, official environment files, active padding study, user videos, run evidence and root submission.zip

Across mirrored sharp curves, obstacle sides, agreeing/opposing avoidance, early/near obstacle rows, repeated frames and geometry variations, only gas/brake may differ and every steering/detector/pass-side/preview/target-state value remains exact.
Clear launch, straight obstacle, obstacle-free sharp curve, weak curve plus obstacle, distant preview, invalid input, road loss and reset remain complete-action/state exact from matched state.
